sites.name: NCS Resolute
sites.description: Stripped pressure hull used by yard schools for EVA, cutting and damage-control training. New crews sometimes mistake it for a wreck.

sites.name: Mill Six
sites.description: Obsolete refinery abandoned when ore processing centralized. Most valuable machinery is gone, but the structure remains a navigation landmark.

sites.name: Old Tankage
sites.description: Old tanks and trusses surround newer infrastructure. Some sections are museum pieces; others still carry utility lines because replacing them would cost more than maintaining them.

sites.name: Camp Three
sites.description: Small pressure shelters and equipment left when prospecting shifted toward richer deposits. Legally mundane salvage, logistically inconvenient.

sites.name: Pathfinder Relay 2
sites.description: Obsolete navigation relay retained as a surveyed reference point. Occasionally serviced solely because every chart still references it.
